name: Liquid AI
description: Liquid's hosted API starts every organisation with $2 of credit, no card.
overview: Liquid AI hosts its own LFM models and d1 series behind an OpenAI-compatible API at console.liquid.ai. Every new organisation starts with $2 in free credit and no card, enough for a few million tokens on LFM3 1.7B at $0.08 per million input and $0.20 per million output. The same models are also served through OpenRouter and the Vercel AI Gateway, so the keys are interchangeable, and Liquid's open weights stay free to self-host below $10M revenue.
free_access: No card for the credit; pay-per-token after it
Same models also reachable through OpenRouter and Vercel
notes: Small credit, small models — best for testing whether the LFM family suits an on-device or low-latency workload before licensing the weights.
